description:
Pat Callanan Property Sales are thrilled to present this exceptional detached property to the open market for sale by private treaty. Nestled in the peaceful rural location of Carramore, Menlough, Ballinasloe, Co. Galway, the property offers a perfect balance of tranquility and convenience, with easy access to Menlough, Monivea, and Athenry.

This A-rated home is designed for modern living, featuring underfloor heating throughout, powered by an efficient air-to-water heat pump system, along with heat recovery ventilation in each room to ensure optimum comfort and energy efficiency.

The spacious accommodation includes a welcoming entrance hall, a bright and airy living room, a large kitchen/dining area, a pantry, a utility/plant room, and a convenient guest W.C. There is also a generously sized bedroom with an ensuite on the ground floor. Upstairs, you will find three additional bedrooms, including the master bedroom with an ensuite, as well as a family bathroom.

Externally, the property is set on a generous c.0.5-acre site. While the gardens are currently unlandscaped, this provides a wonderful opportunity for the new owners to design their ideal outdoor space.

To truly appreciate the potential of this property, viewing is highly recommended. For further information or to arrange a viewing, please contact Pat Callanan Property Sales Ltd at 091-844818 or by email.
